meta.name: description
meta.content: An agent skill for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, OpenCode, and Pi that turns a high-fidelity mockup into a checked component system in your framework, then keeps building on it.

tabs.name: Codex
visiblePanels:
codex plugin marketplace add hackerpug-ai/pixel-perfect
Copy
codex plugin add pixel-perfect@pixel-perfect
Copy

Note
Two enabled sources create duplicate $pixel-perfect:* namespaces. Remove pixel-perfect@personal first.

Next: open a project that has your design and run /pixel-perfect:init.

tabs.name: Cursor
visiblePanels:
git clone --branch v9.2.0 https://github.com/hackerpug-ai/pixel-perfect
Copy
cp -R pixel-perfect/plugins/pixel-perfect ~/.cursor/plugins/local/pixel-perfect
Copy

Then reload the window.

Note
Copy, don't symlink. Cursor fails on symlinked plugins.

Next: open a project that has your design and run /pixel-perfect:init.

tabs.name: Grok
visiblePanels:
/plugin marketplace add hackerpug-ai/pixel-perfect
Copy
/plugin install pixel-perfect@pixel-perfect
Copy

Then enable it in Grok's /plugins view.

Next: open a project that has your design and run /pixel-perfect:init.

tabs.name: OpenCode
visiblePanels:
git clone --branch v9.2.0 https://github.com/hackerpug-ai/pixel-perfect .pixel-perfect
Copy
mkdir -p .opencode
Copy
ln -s ../.pixel-perfect/plugins/pixel-perfect/.opencode/commands .opencode/commands
Copy
ln -s ../.pixel-perfect/plugins/pixel-perfect/.opencode/skills .opencode/skills
Copy

Next: open a project that has your design and run /pixel-perfect:init.

tabs.name: Pi
visiblePanels:
pi install npm:@hackerpug-ai/pixel-perfect
Copy

Next: open a project that has your design and run /pixel-perfect:init.

visiblePanels:

Copy

Next: open a project that has your design and run /pixel-perfect:init.
